classifications.rationale: The President mandates that the Attorney General file a federal-court petition seeking an injunction against the strikes, while leaving additional requested relief to the Attorney General’s judgment. This directs executive litigation activity; any binding injunction or other legal consequence occurs later only if ordered by the court, rather than being imposed by this segment or dictated for agency issuance.
classifications.evidence: I direct you, at this time, pursuant to the provisions of Section 208 of the Labor Management Act, 1947 (29 U.S.C. 178), to petition in the name of the United States
